Executive Overview & Core Product Story

PragyaaProp transforms residential real estate discovery into a transparent, sequential journey: City → Location → Project → Wing → Flat → Vastu Status. Rather than forcing buyers through generic listings with unverified claims, PragyaaProp applies modern architectural physics (daylight vectoring, cross-ventilation, and cardinal alignment) to individual flats without demanding expensive structural demolition.

🟢 ALIGNED (Emerald)
Inherently harmonious natural orientation. Optimal daylight access, positive entrance orientation, and elemental air circulation.
🟡 BALANCED (Amber)
Functionally harmonious for modern residential living. Everyday spatial comfort with minor practical lifestyle considerations.
🟣 ADAPTABLE (Purple)
Remedy-ready through zero-demolition adjustments: interior furniture reorientation, daylight enhancement, and color balance.

🔒 Confidentiality Feature: Series Number Secrecy
To safeguard builder inventory confidentiality, Series Numbers are intentionally withheld from public discovery cards (rendered as "Confidential until inspection"). The Series Number is exclusively revealed when a user opens the individual Flat Details Modal.

Production Engineering Roadmap

Phase 1: Database Persistence
Migrate from client-side state to PostgreSQL (Supabase/Neon) with builder multi-tenancy and role-based access.
Phase 2: Architectural CAD Parser
Automated DWG/DXF/PDF floorplan ingestion to calculate room centroids against true geographic north automatically.
Phase 3: Builder Self-Service Portal
Self-service bulk inventory uploading, developer dashboard, and CRM integration for consultation leads.
